balls.text: poor bowling there and Karthik has given the Delhi innings a satisfactory end, length ball on middle, steps away and swings it powerfully over deep midwicket
goes for another slog, gets an inside edge onto his pads and refuses the run to keep the strike for the final ball
four more, fullish outside off, makes room and drives superbly over cover to beat Symonds at long-off, Vaas is being tonked
you beauty!! Length ball, another gift, gets under it and heaves it away over deep square leg for a big one
appeal for run out, full toss outside off, struck it wide of Symonds at long-off and scampered back for the second, an accurate throw to the keeper but Karthik dives full length to make it just back
what a gift, sliding down the leg side, he had shuffle across to swing it fine, missed, so did Gilchrist, and they get five runs

run out, low full toss on the off, steps away to cart it through cover, gets an inside edge onto his pads, races down for a single but Gilchrist flicks it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Mishra well short
spoils the over, RP gifts him a juicy full toss on middle, much like the Kolkata bowlers did to Ross Taylor yesterday and he dispatches it over deep midwicket for a massive six, brings up the 150
misses out on the hook, bowled short on middle, rocked back to flay it behind square, got an edge onto his helmet
good over so far, bowled it short on middle, dropped it short of the bowler for a quick single
length ball on middle, got under it, struck well but straight to long-on
Mishra does well, guiding it down to third man to give his senior partner the strike
short and wide, slashed hard, edged it, Gilchrist got a glove on that one, kept it down to just a single as it rolled to short third
tossed up on middle and leg, does the sensible thing, takes a single to long-on to keep the strike
flighted outsideoff, bunts it straight to cover
another long hop, short on the off and spinning away, rocks back and pulls it powerfully wide of long-on for four more
Karthik does well, had moved across, saw a short one, pulled it away behind deep square leg
quick and short on middle and off, goes for the sweep, ends up top-edging it straight to Maqsusi at short fine
short of a length on middle, jabs it wide of midwicket for a single
full toss on middle, perfect chance to clear the ropes, tries to do just that but mistimes it, pull it straight to Teja running in from deep midwicket
does it on the off side this time, full outside off, made room and lofted it cleanly between long-off and deep cover, beautifully timed
nicely picked up, on middle and leg, chips it in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket for a boundary
straying down the leg side, tries to sweep it fine, clips the pads to fine leg
pushed it fuller, on middle and off, dug out back to the bowler
low full toss outside off, eased through wide of deep cover for two more
beautifully struck, he had been trying to find that gap but mistimed on two occasions, he finally gets it right, bowled fuller this time and he swipes it firmly to earn a timely boundary
yorker, outside off, all he can do is dig it out back to the bowler
banged in short outside off, two more, mistimes a pull wide of long-on again
back of a length on the off, pulls it wide of long-on, there's enough time for him to race back for the second
almost beat short third there but Maqsusi is trying his best to make amends for his horrendous over, slides to his right to keep them down to a single
fullish on leg stump, driven straight to deep midwicket
an offcutter missed by Karthik, was in the slot, tried to swing it away over midwicket, but couldn't connect
superbly done, third man is up and Karthik got the right ball, short on the off stump, opened the face to place it perfectly between point and short third
length ball outside off, drilled down to ground to long-off
full toss on middle, swung away to deep midwicket for a single
bowled on a length on the off, mid-off is up, pushed to the same fielder
full toss outside off, hit straight to cover
back of a length outside off, tries to slash it past point, misses

Sehwag's short innings comes to an end, Symonds redeems himself, slower one bowled short of a good length on the off, Sehwag had made his mind up, went after it, tried to clear long-off though the shot wasn't really on, skied it straight to Symonds who judged it well this time
good ball, almost in the blockhole again, drags it to midwicket for a single
freehit coming, almost a yorker, played away to midwicket

slower one bowled on a length outside off, made room and struck it over extra cover, there were three fielders chasing that, Rohit and Symonds, the two droppers included, and one of them, Symonds I think ends up kicking it to the boundary
short outside off, cut away to third man for a single
nicely done, good length on the off, moves across, drops it gently in the yawning gap between midwicket and square leg and gets a run
fullish on middle and leg, presents the full face to drive it down the ground to long-on
pushed down to midwicket, struck firmly but straight to the fielder
angling on and down the leg stump, tries to swing it away over the in-field on the leg side is hit on the pads, rolls down on the off side
good length on the off, driven straight to a deepish cover inside the circle, struck firmly so no single
slower one bowled full on the off, drilled down the ground to long-off
good length on the off, a big backlift there, played away wide of point, rushes through for the single
a touch fuller, flighted, fails to beat cover yet again
straight on the off, pushed to cover off the front foot
quicker one bowled flat outside off, stepped out, made room and carted it wide of deep cover, only for a single though
flat and wide, cut it away wide of point but a diving stop save a couple of runs
makes room, he's in attacking mode here, bunts it towards deep point
flighted on the off, makes room, pushes it wide of cover for a single
tried to play it square on the off side, got a thick inside edge towards mid-off instead, they sneak a single
a low full toss on leg stump, thumped down the ground to long-on towards Symonds again, who fumbles but no damage done
pushed through to long-on for a single

dropped, Symonds drops a sitter, length ball on middle, went after it first up, that;s how he plays, lofts it straight to long-on and Symonds spills it despite being in a perfect position to clasp that
full on middle and leg, driven down to long-on for a single
quickish delivery on the off, dropped short of extra cover for a quick single

a wicket at the stroke of the time-out, flighted outside off, had been kept quiet for a while and charged down when he sensed he chance, got to the pitch and lofted it straight to Rao at long-on, presented a full face, but timed it too well in the end to find the fielder
slightly short iutside off, tries to open the face to get it past short third, misses
flighted on the off, pushed down towards deep cover for a run
short and wide, moved back and chopped it down to point
short of a good length on the off, punched wide of midwicket for a single
down the leg side, looks to sweep fine, misses, but gets a run
full outside off, driven through the line to long-off
eased through the covers for a single

Ravi Teja spills it this time, bowled short on the off, pulled away wide of long-on, Teja is well inside the ropes and has to run back to clasp that one, ends up palming it over the ropes, would count as a drop
bowled on a length on the off, driven straight to extra cover
fullish on the off stump, driven down to long-on for a single
back of a length outside off, cut down delicately to short third, failed to find the gap
charges down the track and bunts it back past the bowler towards long-on for one more
on middle and leg, drifting into the batsman, closes the face to work it between square leg and midwicket for a single
arm ball bowled short on the off, cut away straight to point
a touch too short outside off, slapped to deep cover
much straighter, pushed it in the direction of long-on for a single
AB is away, there wasn't too much width, but AB waited for it to spin away, made room to cut it fiercely behind point for a boundary
slightly short on the off, cut down to point
stump-to-stump, on leg stump, well run, tickled it behind square between deep square and fine leg for two runs
bowled on a good length on the off, dabbed wide of point for a quick single
fullish, testing him outside off, a dibbly dobbly half-volley, AB lets it go, not tempted

and now, what a relief! Almost cleared the ropes again, length ball, smashed it from the crease wide of long-on but not well enough, Ravi Teja held his nerve, retained his balance and took an excellent catch running to his right
Gambhir does the sensible thing, giving Dilshan the strike by clipping it to deep square leg

the run-fest continues, Maqsusi's out of the attack for sometime now, full and wide, makes room and crunches that powerfully wide of mid-off, 24 from the over, equal with the most expensive over in the IPL this season
this is a walloping, pushes in a length ball on the off, Dilshan gets his left foot out of the way and strikes it cleanly over mid-on for another boundary
terrible start for Maqsusi, short and wide, makes way and creams it over cover and point, the square boundaries are short and both fielders chasing it have no chance
back of a length on the off, punched to mid-off , gets a single, and another one on the overthrow
and again, and this time, it's timed even better, fetched it from the off stump and hand enough bat on it to clear the fine-leg boundary
plays the paddle scoop, short of a length on the off, bends low and though it's boucing over him, helps it over short fine
missed out, hurled it short, and wide, Gambhir made room to crash through the point region, failed to make contact
on middle and leg, a touch fuller, pushed back to the bowler
short  down the leg side, tries to help it on its way fine, misses, so does the keeper and they get two runs
short of a length on middle, plays a short-arm pull to midwicket, no run there
short again, gets the treatment, DIlshan tocks back and punches it firmly between point and cover, timed it well enough to take it to the ropes
back of a length on middle and off, pushed off the back foot to mid-off
short of a length outside off, slashes hard, misses, will feel he missed out there, that's his most favoured shot
bowled at 115.6 kmph, tried to nudge that to third man but played inside the line there, probably was a bit away movement
teasing him around off stump, reaches forward, plays it wide of cover
beaten this time, a touch too close to play the shot perhaps, shaped it away from Dilshan who tried to guide that to third man, but it cut away
back of a length on middle, eased through to third man between slip and guly
on middle and off, dropped on the off side short of cover
length ball on the leg stump, meaty, juicy, call it what you like and Gambhir dismisses it over the deep square-leg boundary
good length on middle and leg, pushed to midwicket

dropped a sitter,. Rohit Sharma spills it at a shortish gully and hurls a barrage of abuse at himself, short outside off, tried to upper cut it over the keeper, was caught on the glove and Rohit bent forward to pouch that one, didn't have to move much, and spilt the easiest of chances, terrible, atrocious fielding
back of a length on the off, pushed away to point from the crease
bowled on a length on the off, pushed wide of mid-off for a single
overpitched outside off, driven firm and hard but straight to the fielder at cover
got it to move away just a touch, landed on a probing length outside off, he prodded at it and was beaten by the swing
neatly struck, giving him width this time and he latches on, carting it powerfully over point for another four
poor ball, full toss on middle, has no trouble swinging it away wide of deep square leg for a one bounce four
oversteps, short of a good length on the off, dabbed short of point for  quick single, freehit coming
good length on middle and off, defended watchfully back to the bowler

does him in by the slower one, an offcutter to the left-hander, came down the track and tried to smash it over his head, failed to pick the pace, miscued it and Venugopal Rao running back from mid-off judged it well
tight line, straight on middle, bowled at 122.1 kmph, pushed back to the bowler
bowled on a length on middle and off, worked away wide of midwicket for a couple
excellent fielding, short and wide, swatted just wide of cover where Symonds dived  to his right to save a certain four
quick single, good length on the off, dropped short of midwicket and scampers off
back of a length on middle and off, jabs it wide of midwicket to get off the mark
straying down the leg side this time, looks to clip it fine, misses, but gets a wide
full outside off, swinging away, reached for it and mistimed it to cover
back of a length on middle, leaps and turns it behind square for a single
a loosener, bowled at 121.9 kmph, shaping into the left hander but wide enough for him to let go
he's holed out in the deep, can't really blame him, low full toss on middle, struck down AB de Villiers' throat at long-on
almost all over now, bowled round his legs, was the offcutter, moved too across to clip it behind square, missed and the leg stump took a beating
dot ball, full and wide, tried to dig it out, missed and Karthik kept well to it, recovered nicely despite a fumble
a single, full and wide, eased to deep cover, Bhatia won't mind this, the danger man is off strike now
full outside off, dug out towards cover for a quick single
Vaas squeezes in a four, a much-needed one, length ball on leg stump, swung away wide of a diving midwicket

run out, what a collapse, brilliant work from Nehra, RP was struck on the chest and scampered for a single, he was blocking Nehra's view as he was running down towards the non-striker's end but the bowler somehow managed to squeeze a throw through RP's reach to strike the stumps and find him well short

gone! Venugopal Rao has gloved that to the keeper, bowled it short on the off, tried to guide that past the keeper, clipped the left glove and went straight to Karthik, the umpire took a long time but eventually made the right decision
good length on middle, drilled down to long-on where AB slides and keeps them down to a single
good length outside off, slices it away wide of point, a fumble in the dep by Mishra allows them to come back for the second
slower one bowled short outside off, slashed straight to point, dot ball
low full toss on the off, driven down to long-off
Smith has thrown it away, legcutter,a slower one on middle and off, had a massive swing at it, missed and it cut away to clip offstump
length ball on the off, pushed to long-off for a single
done in by the slower one!! Big wicket for Delhi. Dibbly dobbly on middle, Symonds was into the attempted flick too early, clipped his pads before crashing into middle and off
low full toss on the off, driven down to long-on
he's gone, Delhi finally strike! Banged in short on middle, went for the hook, got the top edge and it landed straight into the palms of Bhatia at fine leg
misses this time, goes for the upper cut, short outside off, fails to make contact, dot ball, better over from Nannes
back of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single
bouncer, too short outside off, went to hoick that over midwicket, bowled quick though, a dot ball
bowled it short on middle, made room and slapped it over the bowler's head, wide of long-on for a couple more
length ball on middle and leg, flicked away to deep square leg
slower one, bunts it uppishly towards deep cover for a single, keeps the strike
short of a good length on the off, mistimes a pull, but it's in the gap, between fine leg and deep square leg for a couple
slower one this time and he failed to make contact, as he often has while attempting the big swipe over midwicket
Nehra's had an awful day, banged it short outside leg stump, Teja gives himself some space and pulls it away fine, well wide of fine leg, for four more
innovative, finally, the muscular shots didn't work for him and he moved across to scoop a full delivery wide of short fine for a boundary
dropped, yorker length on middle, tries to push it into the leg side, ends up playing it uppishly straight to Nehra who drops a regulation chance
keeps the strike, single off the last ball, shuffles to work it away behind square, is hit on the pads
Teja misses again, good length outside off, makes room to flay that through cover, makes no contact
short and wide again, but it's a different batsman facing this time, Teja misses an attempted cut, bowled at 133.3 kmph
banged in short on the off, hit high on the thighs as he tries to work that away behind square
identical delivery and appropriately dealt with, made room to smash that over point yet again, didn't learn from his mistake and got punished
he's smacked for four first ball, poor ball really, short and wide, cuts it away over point well wide of third man for a boundary
gave it some air again, pushed it uppishly past the diving Mishra to long-off for a single
flighted on middle, worked away behind square, wide of deep square leg for a couple more
flighted outside off, lands full, has a wild swing but it spins away to beat the bat
creamed wide of long-off but Warner runs well and slides to his left to keep them down to just a couple
good running, pushed gently to long-on, comes back for the second, there's enough time
that's disappeared, pushed it short on middle, waited for it to spin away, rocked back and pulled it disdainfully over deep midwicket
straying on the pads, length ball, clipped it stylishly behind square to bisect the gap between fine leg and deep square leg
pushed it too wide this time, Teja chased it but failed to reach
slower one bowled short outside off, 100.2 kmph, made room to slash that though point, made no contact
length ball on middle, driven to midwicket on the circle, gets a single
down the leg side, banged it short, concedes a run
slower full toss outside, makes room and taps that to point
short of a good length on middle, pulled away over midwicket for a timely boundary, MIshra dives valiantly but isn't able to drag that back
fullish on middle, driven wide of midwicket who palms it to mid-on
the googly again, defended watchfully towards cover this time
googly bowled quick on the off, chipped over the bowler towards long-on
gets forward and swipes that wide of midwicket for two more
Symonds is wasting no time here, sensed a chance with a flighted one on middle, smashed it over long-on for a big six
flighted outside off, gave him the charge to clatter that past the bowler, mistimed it wide of midwicket
tossed up on middle,. driven down towards long-on for a single
back of a length on the off, defended off the back foot to cover
Sangwan strikes!! Gilchrist is tempted to chase a full ball outside off, tried to drill it through cover, got an inside edge bang onto the off stump, massive blow!
short of a length on middle, went for the pull, miscued it but it fell just short of deep square leg, they wouldn't want to catch him the way he's playing
banged in short outside off, went for a pull, missed out, the umpire thought about giving that a wide but decided not to
low full toss on the off stump, driven straight to mid-off for a single
short of a good length outside leg, tries to work it fine, hit on the pads and he scampers a quick leg bye
tossed up on middle and leg, worked away to square leg
flighted on the off, pushed back to Dilshan
quicker one bowled on a length outside off, eased through to deep point for a single
shortish on the off, much slower through the air, punched to long-on
quicker one bowled full on middle, whipped away to deep square leg
tossed up outside off, pushed back to the bowler
short of a good length outside off, pushed to cover
on middle and off, defended back onto the pitch
one of the flattest sixes I've seen, tossed on middle this time, sweeps it firmly wide of deep square leg, a crowd-killer that, went of the middle, powerfully struck
even Mishra isn't spared, he's in a deadly mood today, tossed up outside off, picked on a length, went down and slog-swept it over deep midwicket for a big one
pitched it short on the off, rocked back and pulled it straight to deep midwicket
shortish on the off, pushed wide of point for a single 50 for Gilchrist, excellent knock but has to bat this out
fullish on the off stump, opens the face to steer that to deep point, and keep the strike
gets the treatment, had been quiet for a bit and unleashed a mostrous slog-sweep to clear deep midwicket with absolute ease
slower one bowled short outside off, >i>92.5 kmph, mistimes a pull to deep square leg
low full toss outside off, drags it down to long-on
short of a good length on the off, moves across and punches it to long-on for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, pushed through the line past the bowler for a single
much slower through the air, went back to cut that past point, missed
tossed up outside off, driven down the ground to long-off
went on straight, moved across, adjusted well and dabbed it behind point for a single
held it back again, short outside off, cut away to deep point
flighted on the off, reaches forward and drives it down to long-on
short of a length outside off, makes room and bunts it down to deep cover
good length on the off, moves across and defends it to cover
a full toss again, one that Gilchrist fails to punish, slogs it to deep midwicket for a single
Teja does well, walks across and guides it down to third man, single and Gilchrist is back on strike
in the slot again, a length ball on the off, drilled to mid-on for a quick single
made room, gave him the charge and the bowler chased him, Gilchrist tried to swing that down the leg side, missed
an atrocious delivery that should have been dealt with, gets a wide but will be disappointed, missing out on a clip off a full toss outside leg
to be tonked yet again, slower one bowled full on middle, Giclhrist gets under it and smashes it with contempt well over long-on for one of the biggest sixes this season
bowled short outside off, tried to uppercut that over the keeper, missed out, end of a successful over
down the leg side this time, short down the leg side, gifts a wide
length ball on the off, walks across and defends it to mid-off
back of a length on the off, pushed off the back foot to point

Rohit goes, Sangwan strikes again! Full outside off, in the slot for Rohit who is sucked into the drive but fails to keep it down, strikes it firmly but straight to a perfectly positioned Warner at short cover
just escaped the outside edge, probed him outside off, drew him forward with a good length ball, went for the drive but failed to connect as it angled away
banged in short on middle, helps it to fine leg to keep the strike
superbly timed, bowled short of a good length on the off, went back, stood tall and punched it through mid-off and cover for a delectable boundary
punched off the back foot to cover

dropped, it's Delhi's turn to spill chances this time, short and wide, went for the cut, caught the bottom of the bat and went low towards AB de Villiers at slip who went the wrong way and was struck on the shoe, an embarassing slip that, but could it prove costly?
pushes at it from the crease, gets a thick outside edge to third man
good length on the off, presents the full face to push it to mid-off

oooh almost, Gilchrist planted his foot forward and tried to clear midwicket, but mistimed it and could not get the elevation, was dying on Mishra at midwicket as he dived forward and fell just inches short, an incredibly difficult chance

tame dismissal, slower one bowled short on the off, Suman was caught in two minds, there was never really any conviction in that attempt to clear midwicket, lobbed up straight to Nehra at mid-on, a much-needed wicket that
low full toss on the off, drives it back to the bowler who fumbles and allows a single
short of a good length on middle and leg, whipped down to fine leg
tried to ruffle him with a bouncer, banged in short at 121.2 kmph, but a touch too high, marginal call, given a wide
full and wide, creamed off the front foot but straight to cover
length ball outside off, tries to smack it over mid-off, doesn't connect well though, falls short of him
misses out there, short and wide, chased it, looked to cart it over point but failed to connect, Nannes will breathe easy
bouncer banged in on middle, too high and concedes a wide

he's murdered that one, failed to get the pull going the previous ball but executed it perfectly here, in the slot though, short on the off, picked the length early and smashed it over deep square leg for a massive six
almost got him there, banged in short outside off, tried to clear mid-on but mistimes the pull, falls just short, a touch fortunate there
Gilchrist is in prime form today, low full toss on middle, just flicks it between midwicket and long-on, nicely timed
back of a length outside off, tries to guide it wide of point, but a dive from Dilshan prevents any damage
back of a length on the off, defended to cover
and again, some swing away from the left hander, bowled too full again, just eases it into the gap between cover and mid-off, 18 off the over, Deccan are away
what a start, full and wide, in the slot for Gilchrist, latches on to the half-volley, driving it firmly wide of mid-off for four more
fullish on middle, flicked away wide of square leg for a couple but the umpire calls it one-short though replays suggest he had grounded it over the line
straying on the pads, moves across a hint and clips it down to the fine-leg boundary, he's off
excellent timing, just guided it, no brute force involved there, short of a length on the off, bisected the gap between cover and point and it raced away
short of a length outside off, slashed away to third man
